{{Quote|Will he be doing that often? If so, I suggest we store the fruit in an enclosed space.|Haninum Tyk Rhinann, to Jax Pavan, about Kajin Savaros's destruction of the fruit|<ref name="Patterns" />}}
'''Domrai fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] whose insides consisted of liquid and pulp. Additionally, the fruit was edible by at least some [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Patterns" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Kajin Savaros]] involuntarily [[Force power/Legends|used]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to pulp a domrai fruit being held by an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] named [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] in the [[Poloda Place]] apartment of the Human [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], Pavan was [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] Savaros to use the Force, which led to Savaros losing control and unleashed his powers on several objects throughout the apartment&mdash;including the fruit&mdash;which splattered over Rhinann's [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] while he was in a nearby room. The event caused Rhinann to ask Pavan about whether Savaros's powers would necessitate storing the fruit in an enclosed area.<ref name="Patterns" />

==Behind the scenes==
Domrai fruit first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]]<ref name="Patterns" /> with help from [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]].<ref name="Bohnhoff">{{WebCite|url=http://paperdragonink.com/?p=1817|text=Interview with Author Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff >> Paper Dragon ink|author=Lentes, Douglas|date=2012-01-15, 9:39 pm|work=Paper Dragon ink|archivedate=20120120015419}}</ref>
